name: Syro Phenician
overview: The Syro Phenician woman, a Canaanite from the region near Tyre and Sidon, approached Jesus seeking healing for her demon-possessed daughter. Although Jesus initially did not respond and emphasized His mission to the lost sheep of Israel, the woman humbly persisted, worshipping Him and asking for help. Jesus used the metaphor of children's bread and dogs to test her faith, ultimately demonstrating that His mercy extends beyond Israel to those who come to Him in faith and humility.
